Amit — thanks for the clear requirements and the MAP/SOW. Looping in Rishi (capacity planning) and Connor (dedicated ops) to give a quick readout and options. High level: we can support the target throughput and latency, but the SKU mix and hold type will change unit economics.

Options we'd propose now (provisional):
1) Soft-hold (60 days): reserve equivalent of 4 x c6-h100 (multi-tenant ded.) for sustained throughput; supports 1.5M tokens/day with headroom to burst. Converts to dedicated pool on signature.
2) Provisional dedicated pool (30-day minimum billing): 2 x c6-h100 reserved + autoscaling burst to 6 x c6-h100 for peak windows; better latency and isolation.
3) Hybrid reserved/spot: reserve baseline of 2 x a100-q8 nodes + burst on H100s during peak (cost-optimized) — requires workload quantization validation.

I'm attaching our current capacity snapshot; Rishi, Connor — can you confirm availability windows and any blackout dates between Sept-Nov? Also please flag if we need to pre-allocate NVLink cages or cross-region redundancy for the pilot.

Best,
